address: 26-28 Bruton Place, Mayfair, London, W1J 6NG, United Kingdom
bio: ‘Silva’ is the Latin word for ‘forest’ and there’s an appropriately verdant, natural vibe to the décor at this former mews house in the heart of Mayfair. Open from breakfast until late at night, it’s the ideal neighbourhood spot; come first thing to watch the world go by while enjoying your shakshuka from a window counter seat or ensconce yourself in the cosy bar with a margarita once dusk has settled. There’s no specific influence to the menu, but the abiding principle is a stripped-back focus on the ingredients – like pure-white halibut steamed to perfection....
